about: Each shipped build's own composed conversation instructions. Up to 0.1.8, printed by importing that build's server/interaction-turn.ts and server/modes.ts and calling instructionsFor(mode, MODES[mode].instructions); v0.1.7 was read from git archive v0.1.7 (6e2f033), 0.1.8 from main 6ee757c. From 0.1.9, printed by calling that build's answerInstructions(mode) in server/answer-format.ts, which composes the mode's text, the answer format and, for Automatic, the decision format last. Every digest in server/instruction-digests.ts is the SHA-256 of one of these texts.
